method: actual PNGs opened with view_image, not inferred from source
observations: Overview port/starboard show single island and bow/stern taper, no repeated island.
Close hangar image visibly shows actual depth, inner frames, floor guidance and scale1 player.
Flightdeck image shows seams, lower catapult slots, rails, single bridge and scale1 reference fighter.
Stern image shows both hollow bells and recessed cores; bow close shows fitted taper.
Classic is deliberately partial carrier visibility; Modern/Chase keep the unchanged corridor framing.
Three radar views show distinct angular states; source shader/uniform/gain probes are CPU, not GPU proof.
Selected-reference gallery shares world scale1 and translations, not per-object normalization.
